introduction: Michigan Legal Help provides free self-help information and tools for Michigan legal issues. Its Guide to Legal Help can identify lawyer referrals.
description: Michigan Legal Help provides free self-help information and tools for Michigan legal issues. Its Guide to Legal Help can identify lawyer referrals.

sections.who: Anyone with a Michigan legal issue can use the site. A referred legal aid organization separately screens eligibility and capacity.
sections.get: Resources cover housing, family, benefits, employment and other topics. The site does not provide legal advice or replace a lawyer.
sections.docs:

  • County, case type and the next deadline.
  • Income and household information for a lawyer-referral screen.
sections.apply:
1. Find the relevant topic

    Use Michigan Legal Help’s resource library.

  2. Use the Guide to Legal Help

    Answer the questions about the issue and location to find suitable information and referrals.

  3. Seek local assistance

    Check the self-help-center map, including the courthouse where you will file, and confirm opening hours.
sections.after: Keep court deadlines. A referral or completed tool does not mean a lawyer has accepted representation.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Michigan Legal Help tools and referrals. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is the site only for low-income users?
No. Anyone with a Michigan legal issue may use it.
No. It provides legal information and tools.
How do I find a lawyer?
Use the Guide to Legal Help.
Can someone help me use the tools?
The site lists legal self-help centers.
